# `aitbc energy provider register`

Register a GPU energy profile (EVM contract or native rail).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc energy provider register [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--resource-id` | text | — | yes | Canonical resource ID |
| `--provider-address` | text | — | yes | Provider wallet address |
| `--model-id` | text | — | yes | GPU model ID |
| `--tbp-watts` | integer | — | yes | GPU TBP (total board power) in watts |
| `--eur-per-kwh` | float | — | yes | EUR per kWh tariff |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet name for signing |
| `--wallet-path` | text | — | no | Direct wallet file path |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--json-output` | flag | `false` | no | Output raw JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc energy provider register --resource-id <resource_id> --provider-address <provider_address> --model-id <model_id> --tbp-watts <tbp_watts> --eur-per-kwh <eur_per_kwh>
```
